cases.sentence: Как написано в книге пророка Исаии, ___ раздается в пустыне.
cases.explain: Голос is the subject of раздается (rings out) → nominative.

cases.sentence: Уже и топор лежит у ___ деревьев.
cases.explain: The preposition у (at) takes the genitive → корня.

cases.sentence: Иоанн пошел по всем областям, прилегающим к ___.
cases.explain: The preposition к (bordering/toward) governs the dative → Иордану.

cases.sentence: Ирод ко всему злу добавил еще одно, заключив ___ в темницу.
cases.explain: Иоанна is the direct object of заключив (having locked up) → accusative. Иоанн is animate, so its accusative matches the genitive form.

cases.sentence: Никого ложно не обвиняйте и довольствуйтесь своим ___.
cases.explain: The verb довольствоваться (be content with) governs the instrumental → жалованием.

cases.sentence: Слово Бога было к Иоанну, сыну Захарии, в ___.
cases.explain: В (in), marking location, takes the prepositional → пустыне.

reading.ru: слово Бога было к Иоанну, сыну Захарии, в пустыне.
reading.question: To whom did the word of God come in the wilderness?
reading.explain: The word of God came to John, the son of Zechariah, in the wilderness.

reading.ru: Иоанн пошел по всем областям, прилегающим к Иордану, и проповедовал крещение в знак покаяния для прощения грехов.
reading.question: What did John proclaim as he went through the regions near the Jordan?
options: A baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins
A new law replacing Moses' commandments
The coronation of a new king
A call to arms against Rome
reading.correct: A baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins
reading.explain: John preached a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins throughout the region near the Jordan.

reading.ru: «Приготовьте путь Господу, сделайте прямыми дороги его. Всякий овраг пусть будет засыпан».
reading.question: What did the prophet Isaiah's words, quoted about John, command?
options: "Prepare the way for the Lord, make his paths straight"
reading.correct: "Prepare the way for the Lord, make his paths straight"
reading.explain: The quotation from Isaiah says, "Prepare the way for the Lord, make his paths straight."

reading.ru: «Тот, у кого две рубахи, пусть даст одну тому, у кого нет вообще, и тот, у кого есть еда, пусть сделает то же самое».
reading.question: What did John tell the crowd to do when they asked 'What then must we do?'
options: Share clothing and food with those who have none
reading.correct: Share clothing and food with those who have none
reading.explain: John told them that whoever has two shirts should share with the one who has none, and likewise with food.

reading.ru: «Не вымогайте у людей денег силой и угрозами. Никого ложно не обвиняйте и довольствуйтесь своим жалованием».
reading.question: What did John tell the soldiers to do?
options: Not extort money by force or false accusation, and be content with their wages
Give their weapons to the poor
reading.correct: Not extort money by force or false accusation, and be content with their wages
reading.explain: John told the soldiers not to extort money by force or threats, not to falsely accuse anyone, and to be content with their wages.

reading.ru: «Я крещу вас водой, но придет тот, кто могущественнее меня, я даже не достоин развязать ремни его сандалий.
reading.question: What did John say about the one who was coming after him?
options: He was more powerful than John, whose sandal straps John was not worthy to untie
He would arrive with a great army
He would build a new temple in Jerusalem
He would rule as governor of Judea
reading.correct: He was more powerful than John, whose sandal straps John was not worthy to untie
reading.explain: John said he baptized with water, but one more powerful was coming, whose sandal straps he was not worthy to untie.

reading.ru: Ирод ко всему злу добавил еще одно, заключив Иоанна в темницу.
reading.question: What did Herod do to John after being rebuked by him?
options: He shut John up in prison
He made John a royal advisor
reading.correct: He shut John up in prison
reading.explain: Herod, rebuked by John, added to his evils by locking John up in prison.

reading.ru: и на него спустился Святой Дух в телесном виде, в образе голубя, и с небес прозвучал голос. «Ты мой любимый сын, в Тебе моя радость».
reading.question: What happened when Jesus was baptized and praying?
options: The Holy Spirit descended on him like a dove and a voice from heaven called him the beloved Son
The sky turned dark for three hours
A crowd of angels sang praises
reading.correct: The Holy Spirit descended on him like a dove and a voice from heaven called him the beloved Son
reading.explain: The Holy Spirit descended on Jesus in bodily form like a dove, and a voice from heaven called him the beloved Son.
